EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows a very strong aromatic ring-breathing band at 1005 cm⁻¹, two ring C=C stretches at 1595 and 1614 cm⁻¹, and an aromatic C–H stretch at 3081 cm⁻¹ (consistent with GFQ-003). The band at 1028 cm⁻¹ fits an S=O stretch of a sulfinyl group conjugated to an aromatic ring, and the 620 cm⁻¹ feature is consistent with an S–Cl stretch; together these strongly support a sulfinyl chloride attached to a pyridine ring. The intense 771 cm⁻¹ band can be assigned to a ring mode of the substituted aromatic system. Overall, O=S(Cl)c1ccccn1 best accommodates the ring and sulfuryl chloride signatures.
